param.name: reference_source_selector
param.label: Will you select a reference genome from your history or use a built-in index?
param.help: Built-ins were indexed using default options. See `Indexes` section of help below
param.option: Use a reference from history and build index if necessary

validator.message: No built-in reference genome is available. Ask your administrator to install one using the minibwa index builder data manager.

param.name: ref_file
param.label: Use the following dataset as the reference
param.help: You can upload a FASTA sequence to the history and use it as reference. The index is built transparently before mapping.

section.name: index_options
section.title: Index building options
section.help: These control how `minibwa index` builds the index for the reference taken from your history. The defaults are fine for almost all genomes.

param.label: Suffix array sample rate, as 1/(2^INT)
param.help: -u; default=4; a larger value yields a smaller index at the cost of slower mapping

param.label: Use the low-memory BWT construction algorithm
param.help: -l; a GPL'd algorithm that needs less memory for large genomes. It is single threaded, so the thread count has no effect when it is enabled.

param.label: Block size for the low-memory algorithm
param.help: -b; default=10m; only effective together with the low-memory algorithm above. Accepts suffixes, e.g. 10m.
